spec.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(created_at) AS time, round(quantile(0.5)(dateDiff('second',created_at,started_at))) AS "p50", round(quantile(0.9)(dateDiff('second',created_at,started_at))) AS "p90" FROM default.workflow_job WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND arrayExists(x -> x IN ('macos-m1-stable','macos-m1-14'), labels) AND dateDiff('second',created_at,started_at) >= 0 AND status != 'queued' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
